text:
sam: seeing weird quality regressions on canary with very small batches (1-3), FP8 seems to blow up logits on a subset of long prompts. anyone else?
ellie: yep noticed that too in yesterday's shadow run, skewed token probs after step ~40. logs show NaN spikes in scaled activations. :grimacing:
zoe: small-batch behavior isn't surprising — per-layer quant stats are noisy when batch size < 4, fp8 scaler/per-channel stats get poor estimates. basically calibration garbage.
sam: can we make runtime fall back to int8/4bit earlier for tiny batches? current fallback only triggers on per-token degscore which lags.
ellie: fallback is too coarse. we should add a fast-path check for batch_size <= 3 that consults a lightweight stability metric (variance of scale) to preemptively switch. cheap to compute.
zoe: +1. also think we should expose a per-request hint so caller can declare "single-shot" workloads (batch_hint: "small"), avoid runtime heuristics entirely for predictable apps.
sam: that changes API surface. prefer adding an optional header/param rather than changing core contract. e.g. in generation call: `batch_hint: "small"` or `precision_preference: "safe"`.
ellie: example config prototype: ```json
{"quant_profile": {"mode":"auto","fallback_threshold":0.7,"min_stable_batch":4}, "hint": {"batch_hint":"small"}}
```
zoe: we need to be careful: giving callers control can be abused and increase cost. default behavior must be conservative. but hint opt-in is fine.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: canary v3.14 pushed to shadow with metric tags `quant.smallbatch=true` at 16:02 UTC.
sam: ok rollout plan: 1) add fast-path variance check + immediate int8 fallback for batch<=3, 2) add optional `batch_hint` param (non-breaking), 3) telemetry flags to surface small-batch regressions, 4) canary for two weeks. sound right?
ellie: add: include an A/B flag to monitor cost delta for customers using the hint, we need cost telemetry per-caller.
zoe: ops question: what's the threshold for variance? proposing: coeff var of per-channel scale > 0.25 -> unstable. we should run offline to verify.
sam: action items: sam -> implement fast variance check + unit tests; ellie -> add telemetry tag and cost counters; zoe -> prototype `batch_hint` param + docs; schedule offline bench run w/ existing shadow logs by EOD.
ellie: quick test snippet for runtime check: ```py
scale = compute_scales(tensor)
if batch_size <= 3 and np.std(scale)/np.mean(scale) > 0.25:
    trigger_fallback('int8')
```
sam: thanks. if we see cost blowup in canary we'll dial fallback only for long prompts (>256). also add per-model opt-out.
zoe: leaving a note: this also affects KV-cache warmup; small-batch warmups are noisier. include kv-cache stability tag in telemetry.
ops-bot: reminder: open PR template exists at https://git.redwood/infra/quant-smallbatch with checklist. :thumbsup:
sam: cool — I'll open the PR + link bench results. will ping once green. :eyes:
